title: Hunts FH-011: Establish staging and switches

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 0, Release. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Seed synthetic legacy rows, create capability switches, observability and rollback proof. Done when: Exact SHA staging checks pass with all switches off and no legacy check-in, reward or commerce regression. Requires: FH-005, FH-008, FH-009, FH-010. Owner role: Release engineering.
